title: Derive phase eligibility from durable evidence and content hashes
body:
## Outcome
Implement evidence storage and the pure phase-DAG evaluator without a workflow cursor.

## Scope and acceptance
Persist typed phase evidence on goals and immutable artifact references. Enforce required and declared input hashes; distinguish substantive output from operational metadata. Reject stale submissions, preserve byte-identical outputs on reassessment, support justified evidence withdrawal, and ignore unrelated goal revisions. Apply the same DAG to atomic and parent goals, inherited design authority and parent gates. Closed goals remain inert until reopened. Return bounded eligible steps; diagnostics stay in logs.

## Baseline and falsifiable verification
Current ZzzOps uses separate commands and prose-driven execution; #429 did not ensure the real agent followed delegation. Deterministic fixtures prove restart from backend alone, parallel DAG eligibility, parent/child gates, stale rejection, unchanged-output preservation, withdrawn evidence and reopened stale goals.

## Boundaries
Implements parent #430. Follow the [agreed design](https://github.com/david-rzepa/zzzops/issues/430#issuecomment-5704365166) and [efficiency/root-only interaction constraints](https://github.com/david-rzepa/zzzops/issues/430#issuecomment-5704529135). No parent implementation or general workflow-engine expansion. Stop affected work on unresolved contract or authority gaps; preserve useful independent preparation. Dependencies gate implementation, not read-only preparation.
